text: A well-defined goal is the foundation of any successful project. To ensure clarity, your goals should be SMART: Specific, Measurable, Achievable, Relevant, and Time-bound. Once the main goal is set, break the work down into smaller milestones. These checkpoints allow the team to track progress and celebrate small wins. Each milestone leads to a specific deliverable, which is a tangible result, such as a report or a working prototype. Finally, it is crucial to secure stakeholder alignment early on. By communicating your vision and objectives to everyone involved, you ensure that all parties support the plan and work towards the same definition of success.
